mission_08: For the button, use transition: all 0.3s ease and change transform: translateY(-2px) on hover for a lift effect.
Define @keyframes spin that rotates from 0deg to 360deg, then apply animation: spin 1s linear infinite to the spinner.
Create @keyframes fadeIn from opacity: 0 to opacity: 1, and @keyframes pulse that scales up and down with opacity changes.
